longTitle.officialTitle: To amend the Lacey Act Amendments of 1981 to clarify provisions enacted by the Captive Wildlife Safety Act, to further the conservation of certain wildlife species, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Big Cat Public Safety Act”.

subsection.heading: In General.—
subsection.chapeau: Section 2 of the Lacey Act Amendments of 1981 (16 U.S.C. 3371) is amended—

paragraph.content: by redesignating subsections (a) through (k) as subsections (b) through (l), respectively; and

by inserting before subsection (b) (as so redesignated) the following:
“(a) Breed.—The term ‘breed’ means to facilitate propagation or reproduction (whether intentionally or negligently), or to fail to prevent propagation or reproduction.” .

paragraph.heading: Consolidated farm and rural development act.—
paragraph.chapeau: Section 349(a)(3) of the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act (7 U.S.C. 1997(a)(3)) is amended—

paragraph.heading: Lacey act amendments of 1981.—
paragraph.content: Section 7(c) of the Lacey Act Amendments of 1981 (16 U.S.C. 3376(c)) is amended by striking “section 2(f)(2)(A)” and inserting “section 2(g)(2)(A)”.

section.heading: PROHIBITIONS.
section.chapeau: Section 3 of the Lacey Act Amendments of 1981 (16 U.S.C. 3372) is amended—

clause.content: in subparagraph (A), by striking the semicolon at the end and inserting “; or”;
in subparagraph (B)(iii), by striking “; or” and inserting a semicolon; and

subparagraph.content: in paragraph (4), by striking “(1) through (3)” and inserting “(1) through (3) or subsection (e)”; and

subsection.heading: Civil Penalties.—
subsection.chapeau: Section 4(a)(1) of the Lacey Act Amendments of 1981 (16 U.S.C. 3373(a)(1)) is amended—

subsection.heading: Criminal Penalties.—
subsection.chapeau: Section 4(d) of the Lacey Act Amendments of 1981 (16 U.S.C. 3373(d)) is amended—

paragraph.content: in paragraph (2), by inserting “(e),” after “(d),”; and

by adding at the end the following:
“(4) Any person who knowingly violates section 3(e) shall be fined not more than $20,000, or imprisoned for not more than 5 years, or both. Each violation shall be a separate offense and the offense is deemed to have been committed in the district where the violation first occurred, and in any district in which the defendant may have taken or been in possession of the prohibited wildlife species.” .

section.heading: FORFEITURE OF PROHIBITED WILDLIFE SPECIES.
section.content: Section 5(a)(1) of the Lacey Act Amendments of 1981 (16 U.S.C. 3374(a)(1)) is amended by inserting “bred, possessed,” before “imported, exported,”.

section.heading: ADMINISTRATION.
section.content:
Section 7(a) of the Lacey Act Amendments of 1981 (16 U.S.C. 3376(a)) is amended by adding at the end the following:
“(3) The Secretary shall, in consultation with other relevant Federal and State agencies, promulgate any regulations necessary to implement section 3(e).” .
